findings.symptom: NW quadrant painted land green; tile 6 must be NE+SE land only. Every placement shows an 8x8 green block protruding into water at a vertex whose other three quadrants are water.
findings.evidence: C8, C9; visible in island-3x.png and island-3x-destination.png as two green stubs on the island west shore, and in coverage-3x.png at the five listed cells (clearest at row 0 col 3 beside the all-water tile 0).

findings.preservation_scope: members 0-5 and 7-15, src/terrain.ts, both neighborhood grids and the destination config unchanged.

findings.asset: animation delivery.candidate member.2 -> assets/motion/frame-2.png (used by idle pose-2 and settle pose-2)
findings.symptom: Entire figure drawn 2 px lower than frames 0/1/3, so with the constant pivot/anchor the rendered feet drop from viewport rows 26-27 to 28-29 for the 120 ms of pose-2 and snap back; the character visibly sinks and pops once per loop and once in the one-shot, contradicting the planted-floor intent.
findings.evidence: C10, C11; visible in step-idle-3x-2.png and screen-idle-3x-2.png against the other poses; perceptible but subtle at 1x.
findings.likely_correction: Shift frame-2 art up 2 rows inside its 16x16 canvas (feet back to rows 12-13) as a successor member for member.2.output; keep pivot [8,14] per the brief rather than editing src.
findings.preservation_scope: members 0, 1, 3 and src/animation.ts unchanged; one successor repairs both clips.

findings.note: frame-1 and frame-3 are byte-identical, so the cycle shows only three distinct images; a ping-pong structure, not a defect against the brief.

Two config_source sha256 values in SPECIALIST-RESULT.json are the retained copies' hashes, not the input files' (see C7). Contents are semantically identical; the operations were run with the correct configs. The remaining 48 references verify.

The NF-06 import layer records renderer_executed false while the outer execute receipt records true. The import step validates the supplied report and retains bytes; it does not itself run the renderer. Both receipts are consistent with one real headless Chrome execution per domain (Chrome 157.0.8103.39 headless, node v25.8.1, temporary user-data-dir removed on cleanup).

mechanical_vs_visual: Mechanical: both fixed-profile executions completed, every pixel/source/clock check passed, bytes served matched the family members, mapping and pivot/anchor placement were correct, authored uneven durations drove observed transitions, the loop wrapped twice and the one-shot clamped. Visual: judged by the caller from the actual captured pixels and the source PNGs, the terrain fails the material-join intent at all seven tile-6 placements and the animation fails the planted-floor intent during pose-2. A mechanical pass coexists with two visual continuity defects. Timing samples establish observed playback only; no subjective live viewing is claimed by caller or specialist. No artistic, engine or human acceptance is asserted.
